rasterize_sparse_ray_bundle: rasterize sparse ray bundle features and depth into image, depth map, and opacity mask tensors
rasterize_mc_samples: rasterize Monte-Carlo sampled 2D point features back onto an image using PyTorch3D point cloud rasterizer
create_pointcloud_from_samples: create a PyTorch3D Pointclouds object from 2D xy coordinates and feature tensors for rendering
render_point_cloud_pytorch3d: render a z-flat point cloud with PerspectiveCameras and configurable point radius and topk z-buffer size
packed_to_padded_conversion: convert packed ray bundle data to padded format using first indices and maximum camera count
